nodes.description: Address of the current contract owner declared in Owned (address public owner).
Pending new owner address declared in Owned (address public newOwner).

Token decimals (uint8) stored by NCO.
Total token supply (uint) stored in NCO._totalSupply.
mapping(address => uint) balances holding account token balances.
mapping(address => mapping(address => uint)) allowed holding ERC20 allowances.
Owned() constructor that assigns owner = msg.sender.
transferOwnership(address) guarded by onlyOwner, sets newOwner.
acceptOwnership() that requires msg.sender == newOwner and swaps owner.
SafeMath.safeAdd(uint,uint) performing overflow-checked addition.
SafeMath.safeSub(uint,uint) performing underflow-checked subtraction.
SafeMath.safeMul(uint,uint) performing overflow-checked multiplication.
SafeMath.safeDiv(uint,uint) performing zero-checked division.
NCO() constructor that initializes metadata and mints the total supply.
totalSupply() view returning _totalSupply minus balances[address(0)].
balanceOf(address) view returning balances[tokenOwner].
transfer(address,uint) moving tokens from msg.sender to the recipient.
approve(address,uint) writing the allowance for msg.sender/spender.
transferFrom(address,address,uint) moving tokens using the caller's allowance.
allowance(address,address) view returning allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
approveAndCall(address,uint,bytes) that sets allowance then calls the spender contract.
Payable fallback function that unconditionally reverts.
onlyOwner function performing an external ERC20 transfer of stuck tokens.
msg.sender, the externally controlled caller address used for ownership and balance bookkeeping.

Division c = a / b inside safeDiv guarded by require(b > 0).
External callback ApproveAndCallFallBack(spender).receiveApproval(...) executed after allowance state write.

edges.reason: Owned constructor assigns the deployer msg.sender to the owner state variable.
msg.sender is trusted to be the deployer and becomes the contract owner.
_newOwner parameter is written into the newOwner state variable.
onlyOwner modifier compares msg.sender with owner before allowing the write.
transferOwnership writes the pending owner into newOwner.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender to equal newOwner before transferring ownership.
acceptOwnership promotes newOwner into the owner state variable.
acceptOwnership clears newOwner to address(0).
safeAdd consumes its first operand parameter a.
safeAdd consumes its second operand parameter b.
safeAdd performs the unchecked-then-verified addition a + b.
Operand a flows into the addition expression inside safeAdd.
Operand b flows into the addition expression inside safeAdd.
The addition result is stored into the local return variable c.
safeSub consumes its first operand parameter a.
safeSub consumes its second operand parameter b.
safeSub performs the subtraction a - b under a require guard.
Operand a flows into the subtraction expression inside safeSub.
Operand b flows into the subtraction expression inside safeSub.
The subtraction result is stored into the local return variable c.
safeMul consumes its first operand parameter a.
safeMul consumes its second operand parameter b.
safeMul performs the multiplication a * b under an overflow require guard.
Operand a flows into the multiplication expression inside safeMul.
Operand b flows into the multiplication expression inside safeMul.
The multiplication result is stored into the local return variable c.
safeDiv consumes its numerator parameter a.
safeDiv consumes its denominator parameter b.
safeDiv performs the division a / b guarded against division by zero.
Numerator a flows into the division expression inside safeDiv.
Denominator b flows into the division expression inside safeDiv.
The division result is stored into the local return variable c.
transfer internally calls safeSub to debit the sender balance.
transfer internally calls safeAdd to credit the recipient balance.
transferFrom internally calls safeSub twice to decrement balance and allowance.
transferFrom internally calls safeAdd to credit the recipient balance.
NCO constructor sets the token symbol.
NCO constructor sets the token name.
NCO constructor sets the token decimals.
NCO constructor sets the total supply.
NCO constructor mints the entire supply into the deployer-designated balance entry.
totalSupply() reads _totalSupply.
totalSupply() reads balances[address(0)] to subtract burned tokens.
balanceOf reads the balances mapping for the requested account.
tokenOwner parameter indexes the balances mapping.
transfer reads and writes the balances mapping for sender and recipient.
Recipient address 'to' is used as a balances mapping key.
Amount 'tokens' is subtracted/added in the balance updates.
msg.sender determines whose balance is debited in transfer.
approve writes the allowance into the allowed mapping.
spender parameter is used as the second key of the allowed mapping.
tokens parameter is stored as the allowance value.
msg.sender is used as the first key of the allowed mapping.
transferFrom reads and writes balances for the from and to accounts.
transferFrom decrements allowed[from][msg.sender].
from parameter identifies the debited account and allowance owner.
to parameter identifies the credited account.
tokens parameter is the amount transferred and deducted from the allowance.
msg.sender is the spender whose allowance is consumed in transferFrom.
allowance reads the allowed mapping.
tokenOwner parameter is the first key of the allowed mapping.
spender parameter is the second key of the allowed mapping.
approveAndCall writes the allowance before performing the external callback.
spender parameter is used as allowance key and as the external callback target.
tokens parameter is stored as allowance and forwarded to receiveApproval.
data parameter is forwarded verbatim to the external receiveApproval call.
msg.sender is the allowance owner and the from argument of receiveApproval.
approveAndCall executes an external call to an attacker-controlled spender contract after the state write.
The caller-supplied spender address becomes the callee of the external callback.
The external receiveApproval invocation can re-enter the token contract while allowance is stale.
transferAnyERC20Token performs an external call into an arbitrary token contract.
tokenAddress parameter becomes the callee contract of the external transfer call.
tokens parameter is the amount passed to the external ERC20 transfer.
A malicious tokenAddress contract can re-enter NCO during the external transfer.
transferAnyERC20Token reads the owner state variable as the sweep destination.
onlyOwner gate compares msg.sender with owner before the external sweep.

The tokenOwner argument only indexes balances inside balanceOf and merges into that function.
Recipient address used solely as a balances key inside transfer, so it merges into the function.

tokens is only the allowance value inside approve and merges into that function.
from is only a balances/allowed key inside transferFrom and merges into that function.

data is forwarded verbatim into the external receiveApproval call and belongs with that unsafe operation.
tokenAddress determines the callee of the external ERC20 transfer and belongs with that unsafe operation.
tokens is the amount passed into the external ERC20 transfer and belongs with that unsafe operation.
